summary: Pure SIMD cubic Bernstein/Bezier polynomial evaluation. Takes a scalar parameter t (a8), squares and cubes it into two lane-0 values, combines t, t^2, t^3 against four read-only SSE constants (xmmword_5D8AC0, dword_5D8AA0, xmmword_5D8AB0, xmmword_5D8A90) to form a per-lane basis weight vector v10, then outputs a weighted blend of four control vectors a4..a7 into *a3. Returns a3. No guards, no callees, no calls.

operations.description: Store scalar parameter t (a8) into SSE lane 0 of v8, square it into lane 0 of a1 (t^2), and cube it into lane 0 of a2 (t^3).
Compute v9 = (t broadcast across lanes) * xmmword_5D8AC0, then add dword_5D8AA0 into lane 0 of v9.
Compute v10 = v9 + (t^2 broadcast) * xmmword_5D8AB0 + (t^3 broadcast) * xmmword_5D8A90, producing the cubic basis weight vector evaluated at t.
Write *a3 = a4*shuffle(v10,0) + a5*shuffle(v10,85) + a6*shuffle(v10,170) + a7*shuffle(v10,255), a per-component weighted blend of the four control vectors using v10.
Return pointer a3 as the __userpurge result.

clean_pseudocode: v10 = v9 + splat(t2) * const_xmmword_5D8AB0 + splat(t3) * const_xmmword_5D8A90
result = a4 * splat_lane(v10, 0) + a5 * splat_lane(v10, 1) + a6 * splat_lane(v10, 2) + a7 * splat_lane(v10, 3)
